# mlua0.12.2 provenance and bounded local accessor

Vendored2026-11-04 from the exact [registry archive](https://static.crates.io/crates/mlua/mlua-0.12.2.crate), SHA-256 `7a7ae6b65bf54b7fdd4cf5b6f44f60862350ebf3fe3779b3a9cc005e7fa14f81`. Original source, MIT license and normalized Cargo metadata are retained. Repository-relative upstream README/CHANGELOG/FAQ/release notes are preserved under `.upstream` names; the local README is a valid-link wrapper. Three compile-included Markdown documentation files keep their original names/content. Upstream: [mlua v0.12.2](https://github.com/mlua-rs/mlua/tree/v0.12.2).

The sole source patch is [RUSTER-local.patch](RUSTER-local.patch), applied with `git apply --unidiff-zero` to the exact registry source and verified to reconstruct vendored `debug.rs` byte-for-byte: safe `Debug::local(index)` for Lua5.4 only. It checks that the borrowed Debug belongs to the currently active Lua state **before touching the stack**, validates a positive `c_int` index, reserves stack slots, guards stack restoration, copies the local name and roots the returned value using upstream's fallible conversion. The extension stays inside this dependency's existing unsafe boundary; Ruster code forbids unsafe. The original disposable trial, review and limitations are recorded in [debugger evidence](../../docs/evidence/M8-lua-debug-trial.md). This is not a universal soundness proof or an engine unsafe-code waiver.

The backend enables `lua54` and `vendored`, without `send`, DEBUG, external loaders or standard-library exposure beyond explicitly copied math functions. Resolved `mlua-sys0.13.0` and `lua-src551.0.2` select the Lua54 branch, `lua-5.4.9`; selected headers define5.4.9, and actual backend tests assert runtime `_VERSION == "Lua 5.4"`. The earlier trial's dynamically linked system Lua5.4.9 remains separate build/distribution evidence. Bundled tests exercise the safe local extension under nested active-coroutine changes and rooted nil/table locals. No sanitizer/Miri/formal soundness claim follows. Root notices own distribution-license inventory. No DAP transport or editor debugger is provided by this crate.

Removal trigger: prefer an upstream safe local accessor meeting the same active-state/lifetime/stack contract after regression review. Do not broaden this patch into a private debugger framework. The normalized manifest is unchanged; root workspace membership/exclusion and dependency notices own integration.
